verdict.rationale: Apify's docs state you can publish Actors on Apify Store and earn regular passive income. The Store is a public marketplace of 64,279 Actors that other users can discover and run, and developers can build their own custom Actors to list there. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the publishing workflow and monetization models (pricing options, revenue share, payouts), independent or hands-on corroboration from developers actually earning revenue.
